name: Unified Multiple System Atrophy Rating Scale
nameZh: 多系統萎縮統一評分量表
developer: Wenning、Tison 等（歐洲 MSA 研究小組 EMSA-SG）
measures: 四部分：Part I 病史/日常活動（12 項）、Part II 運動檢查（14 項）、Part III 自律神經（臥立血壓）、Part IV 整體失能等級。分數越高越差。
development: 為 MSA 量身打造的多維度半量化量表，於 4 中心 40 名 MSA 病人開發驗證。
validation: 內部一致性 Part I α 0.84、Part II α 0.90；多數項目評估者間信度良好；UMSARS-II 與 UPDRS-III、ICARS 高度相關（rs>0.8）。
useInTrials: MSA 試驗事實上的主要療效量表——近期 ATH434、Lu AF82422、ION464 等試驗多以 UMSARS 或 modified UMSARS 為主/次要終點。
taiwan: 公開來源未見台灣本地心理計量驗證；台灣臨床/研究直接沿用。

en.developer: Wenning, Tison et al. (European MSA Study Group, EMSA-SG)
en.measures: Four parts: Part I history/ADL (12 items), Part II motor exam (14 items), Part III autonomic (supine/standing BP), Part IV global disability. Higher = worse.
en.development: A multidimensional semi-quantitative scale purpose-built for MSA; developed and validated in 40 MSA patients across 4 centres.
en.validation: Internal consistency Part I alpha 0.84, Part II 0.90; mostly good inter-rater reliability; UMSARS-II correlates strongly with UPDRS-III and ICARS (rs>0.8).
en.useInTrials: The de facto primary efficacy scale in MSA trials (ATH434, Lu AF82422, ION464, etc. use UMSARS or modified UMSARS as primary/secondary endpoints).
en.taiwan: No Taiwan-local psychometric validation in public sources; used directly in Taiwan.

sources.label: 原始開發驗證 Wenning 2004 Mov Disord

name: Modified UMSARS
developer: 近期藥物試驗端點改良（如 Alterity ATH434 採 modified UMSARS Part I）
measures: 針對藥物試驗重新校準/聚焦的 UMSARS 版本，取對變化較敏感的項目作端點。
development: 為提高試驗靈敏度而改良；心理計量驗證持續進行中。
validation: ATH434-201 Ph2 於 modified UMSARS Part I 達統計顯著改善（2025/01 topline）。
useInTrials: 新藥試驗端點（ATH434-201 Ph2 主要分析用）。

en.developer: Recent trial-endpoint refinement (e.g. Alterity's ATH434 used modified UMSARS Part I)
en.measures: A recalibrated/focused UMSARS version selecting items more sensitive to change as a trial endpoint.
en.development: Modified to improve trial sensitivity; psychometric validation ongoing.
en.validation: ATH434-201 Ph2 showed statistically significant improvement on modified UMSARS Part I (Jan 2025 topline).

sources.label: 改良版 UMSARS 心理計量 (Neurology)

name: Autonomic symptom scales (SCOPA-AUT, COMPASS-31)
developer: SCOPA-AUT：Visser、Marinus 等（荷蘭，2004）；COMPASS-31：Sletten 等（美國 Mayo，2012）
measures: 皆為病人自陳的自律神經症狀問卷。SCOPA-AUT 25 題（腸胃、泌尿、心血管、體溫調節、瞳孔、性功能）；COMPASS-31 為 31 題精簡加權版，可算總分。
development: 量化 MSA 核心特徵之一的自律神經功能障礙（MSA 診斷關鍵，尤其早期）。
validation: 兩者中度正相關（r≈0.61）；COMPASS-31 對 MSA-P 與 PD 的鑑別具篩檢價值。
useInTrials: MSA 試驗的自律神經次要指標（病人自陳）。
taiwan: 有中文版可沿用；MSA 專屬台灣驗證未見。

en.developer: SCOPA-AUT: Visser, Marinus et al. (Netherlands, 2004); COMPASS-31: Sletten et al. (Mayo, USA, 2012)
en.measures: Both are patient-reported autonomic symptom questionnaires. SCOPA-AUT: 25 items (GI, urinary, cardiovascular, thermoregulatory, pupillomotor, sexual). COMPASS-31: a 31-item refined weighted score.
en.development: Quantify autonomic dysfunction — a core, early feature and diagnostic key of MSA.
en.validation: Moderately correlated (r about 0.61); COMPASS-31 has screening value distinguishing MSA-P from PD.
en.useInTrials: Autonomic secondary (patient-reported) measures in MSA trials.
en.taiwan: Chinese versions available; no MSA-specific Taiwan validation found.

name: Borrowed motor scales for MSA subtypes
nameZh: 借用的運動量表（依亞型）
developer: 沿用既有量表（非 MSA 專屬）
measures: MSA-P（帕金森型）借用 MDS-UPDRS Part III（運動檢查）；MSA-C（小腦型）借用小腦失調量表 SARA／ICARS（詳見 SCA 知識庫）。
development: 因 MSA 橫跨帕金森與小腦兩種表現，臨床/試驗常併用對應亞型的既有量表補足 UMSARS。
validation: 各量表信效度見其原始文獻；UMSARS-II 本就與 UPDRS-III、ICARS 高度相關。
useInTrials: 作為 MSA-P／MSA-C 亞型的補充運動指標。

en.measures: MSA-P (parkinsonian) borrows MDS-UPDRS Part III (motor exam); MSA-C (cerebellar) borrows the ataxia scales SARA/ICARS (see the SCA knowledge base).
en.development: Because MSA spans parkinsonian and cerebellar phenotypes, trials often add the subtype-matched scale alongside UMSARS.
en.validation: See each scale's original literature; UMSARS-II already correlates highly with UPDRS-III and ICARS.
en.useInTrials: Supplementary motor measures for the MSA-P / MSA-C subtypes.

sources.label: UMSARS 與 UPDRS/ICARS 相關性 (Wenning 2004)
